about: Our own choices for the generated Filters layout. Facts about darktable (labels, units, ranges, defaults, widgets, tabs) come from omalux/design/ui-map/*.json; build_layout.py combines both into omalux/design/layout.json. Rows are referenced by their layout.json field id.

groups.label: base
groups.note: darktable's 'base' group (modules: all preset), minus the raw-only modules that go to technical

groups.label: correct
groups.note: crop, ashift and flip live in the Geometry pane; only their missing rows are listed

groups.label: technical
groups.note: raw-only and pipeline modules a hobby photographer rarely touches

groups.label: deprecated
groups.note: darktable's own group name; shown only when the image history uses them

hidden.rotatepixels: set automatically for some Fuji sensors (IOP_FLAGS_HIDDEN)
hidden.overexposed: viewer overlay driven from the darkroom toolbar, not an edit
hidden.rawoverexposed: viewer overlay driven from the darkroom toolbar, not an edit

curated.note: Rows already registered in omalux/native/engine/controls.h are dropped from these modules; the remaining parameters are listed so the expanded curated block can append them.

crop.aspect: the Geometry pane has its own aspect chooser

temperature.preset:as_shot: button bar duplicates the 'settings' combobox and is off by default in darktable

filmicrgb.@display_highlight_reconstruction_mask: mask preview overlay not available in Omalux

toneequal.@display_exposure_mask: mask preview overlay not available in Omalux

colorzones.@display_mask: mask preview overlay not available in Omalux

colorbalancergb.@checker_size: settings of the mask preview overlay, which Omalux does not have
colorbalancergb.@checker_color_1: settings of the mask preview overlay
colorbalancergb.@checker_color_2: settings of the mask preview overlay

lut3d.filepath:file_combobox_no_label: merged into the single file row

rawprepare.left: darktable hides raw crop unless plugins/darkroom/rawprepare/allow_editing_crop is set

retouch.@mask_opacity: the selected shape's opacity is set on the photo toolbar

channelmixerrgb.label: calibrating with a color checker on the image — not available yet

colortransfer.label: no controls — this module can only be switched off

equalizer.label: no controls — this module can only be switched off

canvas.note: Rows that open a module's tool on the photograph (PhotoViewport): a row with a button replaces the rows darktable draws on the image. Selecting any row of the module shows the tool too.

retouch.label: shapes
retouch.hint: click a shape, then the photo; drag shapes, their source or edges; wheel resizes

spots.label: shapes
spots.hint: click a shape, then the photo; drag a spot or its source

liquify.label: warps
liquify.hint: add points, lines or curves on the photo; drag centres, radii and strength arrows

graduatednd.label: gradient line
graduatednd.hint: drag the line or its ends on the photo; right-drag draws a new line

ashift.label: structure
ashift.hint: draw lines or a rectangle along the building; right-drag a level line to straighten

vignette.label: vignette
vignette.hint: drag the centre or the inner and outer handles on the photo

primary.note: Collapsed rows (0-2). Default: the inventory's primary-tier sliders, comboboxes and toggles. Overridden where the inventory picks a custom editor or a control that means little on its own.

tier.note: Per-row tier overrides for a hobby photographer.

visible_when.note: Our own visibility choices where darktable's condition is a preference or layout state. Each entry: rows whose darktable condition contains 'match' get 'value'.

colorequal.why: darktable shows the 24 colour sliders only with the show_sliders preference; Omalux always shows them as rows

colors.note: Coloured track overrides; the generator otherwise derives hue/saturation/light/temperature/tint from unit and label.

notes.colisa: Deprecated upstream but kept in the curated block for existing styles; all three controls are curated.
notes.atrous: The curves are the real controls; mix only scales them.
notes.rasterfile: Publishes a raster mask for other modules' blend section; useful only once masks are supported.
notes.highpass: Produces a grey detail layer; meaningful only with a blend mode such as overlay.
notes.censorize: Meant for a drawn mask over the area to hide; Omalux has no mask support yet.
notes.colormapping: Two-step workflow across two images (acquire source, acquire target).
notes.overlay: The overlay is another library image, chosen from the library rather than the file system.
